name: idea-vault
description: Maintain structured project plans and meeting records plus one freeform memo per root-level project folder, using an existing GitHub connection only on explicit user request.

interface.shortDescription: アイデア・議論・自由なメモをGitHubに保存
interface.longDescription: Maintain structured project plans, discussion records, and one freeform memo per root-level project folder. On explicit request, use the existing GitHub connection to save content, configure development hours, stop or resume development, and inspect saved status. A separate private GitHub Actions runner executes authorized development. No additional MCP server is required.
defaultPrompt: このアイデアを要約して
このアイデアをGitHubに保存して
GitHubに保存したアイデアの議論を再開したい
自動開発の時間を設定して
自動開発の状況を見せて
